description: Reported bug: 'I declared a charge, CP re-rolled, succeeded, clicked Snap to Contact, and now the End Charge Phase button does nothing.' Two defects, both driven here through the real UI. (1) ChargeController._input() ran BEFORE Godot's GUI pass and called set_input_as_handled() on every left-click that was not inside one of the three charge-panel buttons, so while awaiting_movement was true the top-right PhaseActionButton — and every other HUD control — never received its press. Nothing was disabled and hover tooltips still worked (motion is only consumed mid-drag), so the game read as broken. The fix returns early whenever gui_get_hovered_control() is non-null (null over the bare board, non-null over any Control). (2) Once the click lands, ending the phase on a staged-but-uncommitted charge move would silently bin a successful charge roll, so Main now raises a 'Confirm your charge move first' prompt whose PRIMARY button performs the missing step. Also asserted: the top status bar names the current charge step instead of a static 'Phase: CHARGE', and the confirm button is the visually primary action of its row. The PhaseActionButton press is a REAL click (click_node without emit_pressed) precisely because emit_pressed would bypass the input path where defect 1 lived.
